verdict.rationale: Gusto's own docs say it offers official client libraries for several programming languages for its API, plus a first-party React SDK component library with built-in payroll business logic. That clearly covers the core of building against official SDKs, though the evidence on specifics is thin. Missing for 10: the specific languages covered and their maturity or versioning, any SDK reference depth beyond one-line mentions, and independent or hands-on confirmation that the SDKs work well.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Gusto Embedded offers official client libraries for several programming languages to help you integrate with our API quickly and reliably.
The Gusto Embedded Payroll React SDK offers component libraries with built-in business logic that helps our developers with the complexity of building with payroll APIs.
A React component library for building payroll—deeply customizable and quick-to-deploy
